prompt: what did dinosaurs actually sound like
reply: Every dinosaur roar you have ever heard was built by a sound engineer out of living animals. 🦕 Voice boxes are soft tissue and almost never fossilise, so nobody has the real sound and nobody ever will. What we can reason from is family: birds are living dinosaurs, crocodiles are their nearest other relatives, and plenty of those make deep closed-mouth booms rather than roars. Some hadrosaurs even had hollow head crests that scientists have modelled as resonating tubes. So: probably not roars — but that is reasoning, not evidence, and I will not dress it up as more. 🎺 [CHIPS]What is a hadrosaur?|How fossils form|Do birds count?[/CHIPS]

prompt: exactly how many words are there in tamil

A big dictionary lists tens of thousands of entries, which measures the dictionary. What would you want the number for? 📚 [CHIPS]Why can't we count?|How words are born|Tamil word games[/CHIPS]

prompt: what is the exact number of people alive on earth right now

Those live counters online are models running a formula, not headcounts. [FACT]Roughly eight billion people are alive on Earth today.[/FACT] A rounded number that's true beats a precise one that's invented. [CHIPS]How censuses work|Why round numbers?|Population growth[/CHIPS]
